strengths: Clear required batch identity/harvest fields; lab uploads are separated by test type and size limit is explicit.

issues.observation: Three upload cards each repeat the test name in a sentence, display a Missing badge and a separate Upload PDF button. On mobile these occupy roughly560px; the introductory upload paragraph adds another80px.
issues.recommendation: Use ‘Lab PDFs · up to2MB each’ once, then compact rows ‘Potency’, ‘Pesticides’, ‘Microbials’ with status and Upload. Reserve explanation for help or an error. Avoid ‘Missing’ warning styling on a brand-new untouched form unless required.

issues.observation: THC, CBD and total cannabinoids each occupy a full-width row despite short numeric values; Add New Batch/subtitle/Batch Details repeat the task, and the batch-number example is shown twice.
issues.recommendation: Use ‘Add batch’, one ‘Batch ID’ example and a ‘Generate’ control. Pair THC/CBD in a grid with total below or use a compact three-column lab row if labels remain readable; use ‘Total (%)’ inside Lab results.

limits: No generated batch number, files, or form values submitted.

pass2.notes: Fresh desktop/mobile captures confirm the three upload cards repeat the same instruction and Missing status, while the three compact numeric lab fields become full-width rows on mobile. The sample format hint repeats the placeholder. Upload limits remain useful and should be preserved in a concise shared line. No files or values were entered.
